items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Linton Garner came in, Erroll Garner's brother.

ctx.x: Say a little more about that if you would.

Well, Timmy was on stage when he was a child, with a thing called "Me and My Shadow". He was a child star and his tradition on stage goes way back. But he liked me because he could see that I had, you know, some potential to be on stage also. And he encouraged me. He was a friend and I learned a lot from him. And of course when we got our act together we played. And, incidentally, Linton Garner came in, Erroll Garner's brother. But this particular thing...we had two girls and Austin Powell, who had the "Cats and…
What was his name, Jumpin' George...?
